status: frozen contract checkpoint for consumer review; endpoints and catalog runtime not implemented
canonicalization: delegation-v1 strict canonical UTF8 JSON; safe integers; reject duplicate keys, floats, invalid UTF8 and prototype keys; resolve only these local definitions

queue-delegated-qualification-v1.mode: qualification only; original signed args preserved; no additional enrollment/access-approval prompt

invariants: Only reserved .example.invalid origins and current existing published post/page fields; production compile block and company code pilot unchanged.
Inspect semantic snapshot before qualification; missing profile is bounded unqualified/pending status, never staff enrollment.

Requester is taken only from verified delegation and stored immutably; worker claims bind stored job/requester/snapshot. Recheck current requester role, Workspace state and authorization before request/capture/publication.
Fresh exact URL resolution and verified one-site native sync then authoritative snapshot comparison before request/capture/publication. Drift needs new request, not silent adoption.
Owner policy configuration excludes backend self-configuration and all delegated staff routes. Registrar/recipe-root keys must differ from identity/QA keys and each other.
Enabled catalog policy requires nonempty registrar/recipe keys and explicit owner-pinned recipe trust; absent or disabled policy cannot queue/capture/publish.
Capture transitions one queued job to running and stores one immutable encrypted capture artifact. Its exact hash is required at publication; no overwrite/auto-recapture under a stale job.
Protected machine requests need pinned backend connection plus purpose-specific signature, exact stored job, current policy/epoch and one-use durable nonce/request claims.
Capture uses only fixed read-only post/parity templates with a private exact-packet signing permit that cannot authorize arbitrary PHP, paths, selectors, URLs, callables or mutations.

Profile publication uses per-target revision CAS and encrypted immutable records. Target replacement/revocation invalidates affected plans; tombstone prevents legacy fallback. Unrelated publication does not alter authorization digest or invalidate another target plan.

Provider publication is provider-only readiness. Gateway and QA runner must independently accept same signed recipe/catalog/binding; current static inventories remain authoritative until separately reviewed transition.
Successful qualification does not approve an edit. Preserve frozen v1/v2 schemas and existing QA, exact approval, backup, CAS, site lock, no-retry uncertainty and separate rollback.
Closed worker failures contain only symbolic reason enums and no raw logs, source, record values, credentials or private keys.
No staff actor/email input to control requests; no manual user allowlist, record/site enrollment, credential creation or production access changes.
Capture artifact hash is the canonical digest of the closed capture_artifact object only; job/profile publication must bind that immutable retained hash.

Initial registrar runtime does not issue durable consumer bindings: qualification_binding must be null. A later separately accepted target-binding contract and consumer trust transition are mandatory for new-target gateway/runner use.

Protected job context exposes immutable requester hash, policy/epoch, expected revision/snapshot/expiry without person/email. Context requests are signature/pinned-service authenticated and scope/job-bound; no raw staff context reconstruction.
Capture retains the original stored expected target revision; concurrent publication blocks stale capture/publication and cannot silently rebase.
qualification_binding is null-only in this frozen initial schema; separate binding lookup/issuance and reviewed consumer migration are future contracts.

Status derives current target revision/profile/binding hash and revocation from authoritative catalog, not historical job. Replaced job returns superseded/target_superseded; revocation returns revoked/target_revoked. is_current requires matching live revision/profile, current authorization/epoch and unexpired job. Old published metadata cannot enable consumer trust.

dispatch_handoff.mode: gateway-owned protected dispatch after receiving exact queued job ID/scope; never a public worker/admin route
dispatch_handoff.request_to_worker: job ID + exact site/target + current authorization digest only; no actor reconstruction, selectors, paths, profile or source overrides
dispatch_handoff.worker_bootstrap: Authenticate to the pinned Dashboard with service transport and purpose-signed context request; retrieve immutable job_context over verified HTTPS. Verify canonical context hash and retain expected target revision/requester hash/snapshot/epoch exactly. Never rebase to a later context.
dispatch_handoff.start: Purpose-signed capture transitions that exact queued job to running; no second job or repeated capture overwrite. Publication binds same expected revision and retained capture.
dispatch_handoff.unavailable: If protected dispatch is absent/rejected, expose bounded blocked/worker_unavailable. Do not leave an apparently progressing orphan queue or promise a worker run.
dispatch_handoff.recovery: No automatic mutation retry; explicit source-safe job failure/expiry, idempotent duplicate job request returns same immutable context.
